summary: Union Alpha is a stealth model that is free on OpenCode Zen for a limited time. Announced by @opencode on 2026-09-16 as "free for the next week" (through ~2026-09-23). OpenCode's docs state its provider follows a zero-retention policy and does not use your data for model training. The model is built for agentic coding and supports image inputs; models.dev lists it as union-alpha at $0 input / $0 output with a 262K context window.
claim_steps: Sign in to OpenCode Zen at opencode.ai/zen and copy your API key.
In the OpenCode TUI, run /connect, select OpenCode Zen, and paste your API key.
Run /models and select Union Alpha (model id: opencode/union-alpha).
Alternatively, call the Zen API directly at https://opencode.ai/zen/v1/messages with model union-alpha.
